player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id} ka Pig Dice wɛlɛ.

Kɔri:
- I ka tɛmɛ, i bɛ se '[roll]' wa '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: I bɛ kɔnɔ i tɛmɛ total
- Roll 1: I bɛ pɔri i tɛmɛ total ani tɛmɛ bɛ na
- Hold: I bɛ kɔnɔ i tɛmɛ total i skɔri la ani tɛmɛ bɛ na
- Fɔlɔ i {winning_score} pɔinti bɛ sɔrɔ i ye

I ka tɛmɛ, i bɛ ye cɛsiri skɔriw ani tɛmɛ total.
I bɛ '[roll]' fɔ i ka roll dɛ wa '[hold]' fɔ i ka bank i pɔintiw.
